title: World Import Bundle bubble, version 0 draft
description: One bubble.json per bubble folder. Draft: version 1 freezes it. Units are metres. Axes are the game's: right-handed, Z up. A glb stores glTF Y-up; Studio's glTF reader maps glTF (x, y, z) to game (x, -z, y). That undoes Blender's default glTF export (+Y Up on), so a scene modelled Z-up in Blender lands in the game unchanged. Convert units and axes once, in Blender. Studio never converts. A static's transform applies scale, then rotation, then position. $defs/bundle describes bundle.json.

name.description: Bubble name. Must match the bubble's folder name.

kind.description: An interior bubble sits in an off-map pocket and is reached by a spawn-point teleport, not by walking.

neighbours.description: Names of bubbles this bubble streams next to. Each link is listed on both sides.

statics.description: Static meshes placed in this bubble. May be empty.

spawn_points.description: Optional. Named places the player can arrive at.

vec3.description: x, y, z in metres, game axes (Z up).

quaternion.description: Rotation as x, y, z, w in game axes. Must be unit length.

bounds.description: Axis-aligned box in metres, game axes. Each min lane is below its max lane.

glb.description: Path to a .glb, relative to the bubble folder, with forward slashes. It may not leave the folder.

facing.description: Optional. Yaw in degrees about +Z. 0 faces +X, 90 faces +Y.

bundle.description: bundle.json at the bundle root. Lists the bubble folders in bubble order.
